newsitem.title: GREECE: Four missing in Greek gunboat collision with ship.
newsitem.headline: Four missing in Greek gunboat collision with ship.

text.p: Four people were missing after a Greek warship collided with a Greek passenger ship and sank off the Aegean island of Samos on Monday, the merchant marine ministry said.

"According to the gunboat captain there was a 38-member crew on board. Of those, 34 have been collected (rescued) and efforts continue to locate and collect the other four," the ministry said in a statement.
The Greek-registered, 1,767 tonne Samaina merchant ship did not suffer serious damage in the incident to the north of the eastern Aegean island at 1635 GMT, it said.
"None of the passengers were injured," the ministry said. It it not give a reason for the collision.

It was the second Greek shipping incident in eight days. On October 26 the Greek passenger ferry Pegassus run aground on a rocky islet off cape Sounion near Athens, injuring several people. One man died a few days later in hospital.
